title: Pure Infernoid
summary: Infernoid cards only, with generic staples. Infernoids summon themselves from the hand or GY by banishing other Infernoids, as long as the Effect Monsters you control total Level 8 or lower, and the big ones negate by tributing a monster. Infernoid Decatron mills an Infernoid and takes its name, Level and effect, so the GY fills quickly. Void Feast summons up to three Infernoids from the Deck with a total Level of exactly 8, and Void Vanishment searches the other Void cards. The 2024 cards lead the Extra Deck. Infernoid Evil is a Level 1 Fusion that mills Infernoids with different names and searches a Void card when it leaves. Infernoid Flood negates a Special Summon and banishes a card whenever something is banished from your GY.
